import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class SAP {
        int[][] cap, flow, g;
        int n;
        int[] h, vh;
        int source, sink;
        int[] mk;
        public SAP(int n) {
            this.n = n;
            cap = new int[n + 1][n + 1];
            flow = new int[n + 1][n + 1];
            g = new int[n + 1][n + 1];
            h = new int[n + 1];
            vh = new int[n + 1];
            mk = new int[n + 1];
        }
        public void init(int n) {
            this.n = n;
            for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
                Arrays.fill(cap[i], 0);
                Arrays.fill(g[i], 0);
                mk[i] = 0;
            }
        }
        public void addCap(int i, int j, int val) {
            cap[i][j] += val;
            g[i][j] = 1;
        }
        public int sap(int idx, int maxCap) {
            if (idx == sink) return maxCap;
            int l = maxCap, d, minH = n;
            for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
                if (cap[idx][i] - flow[idx][i] > 0) {
                    if (h[idx] == h[i] + 1) {
                        d = sap(i, Math.min(l, cap[idx][i] - flow[idx][i]));
                        flow[idx][i] += d;
                        flow[i][idx] -= d;
                        l -= d;
                        if (h[source] == n || l == 0) return maxCap - l;
                    }
                    minH = Math.min(minH, h[i] + 1);
                }
            }
            if (l == maxCap) {
                vh[h[idx]]--;
                vh[minH]++;
                if (vh[h[idx]] == 0) h[source] = n;
                h[idx] = minH;
            }
            return maxCap - l;
        }
        public int solve(int source, int sink) {
            if (source == sink) return Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            this.sink = sink;
            this.source = source;
            Arrays.fill(flow, 0);
            Arrays.fill(h, 0);
            Arrays.fill(vh, 0);
            int ans = 0;
            while (h[source] != n) ans += sap(source, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
            return ans;
        }
    }

    static class Node {
        int x, y, step;
    }

    static int n, t;
    static int sx, sy;
    static int[] dx = {0, 0, -1, 1};
    static int[] dy = {-1, 1, 0, 0};
    static char[][] mat1, mat2;
    static int[][] flag, vis;
    static int ID(int i, int j) {
        return (i - 1) * n + j;
    }

    static boolean check(int x, int y) {
        if (x < 1 || x > n || y < 1 || y > n) return false;
        return true;
    }

    static void BFS1() {
        Queue<Node> Q = new LinkedList<>();
        Node now, next;
        now = new Node();
        now.x = sx; now.y = sy; now.step = 0;
        Q.add(now);
        Arrays.fill(flag, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
        Arrays.fill(vis, 0);
        vis[now.x][now.y] = 1;
        while (!Q.isEmpty()) {
            now = Q.poll();
            flag[now.x][now.y] = now.step;
            if (now.step > t) break;
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                int x = now.x + dx[k], y = now.y + dy[k];
                if (check(x, y) && mat1[x][y] != 'Y' && !vis[x][y]) {
                    next = new Node();
                    next.x = x; next.y = y; next.step = now.step + 1;
                    vis[x][y] = 1;
                    Q.add(next);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void BFS2(int i, int j) {
        Queue<Node> Q = new LinkedList<>();
        Node now, next;
        now = new Node();
        now.x = i; now.y = j; now.step = 0;
        Q.add(now);
        Arrays.fill(vis, 0);
        vis[now.x][now.y] = 1;
        while (!Q.isEmpty()) {
            now = Q.poll();
            if (now.step > t) break;
            if (flag[now.x][now.y] < now.step) continue;
            if (flag[now.x][now.y] == now.step && mat2[now.x][now.y] < '1' || mat2[now.x][now.y] > '9') continue;
            if (mat2[now.x][now.y] >= '1' && mat2[now.x][now.y] <= '9') {
                if (now.x != i || now.y != j) 
                    sap.addCap(ID(i, j), ID(now.x, now.y) + n * n, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
                if (flag[now.x][now.y] == now.step) continue;
            }
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                int x = now.x + dx[k], y = now.y + dy[k];
                if (check(x, y) && mat1[x][y] != 'Y' && !vis[x][y]) {
                    next = new Node();
                    next.x = x; next.y = y; next.step = now.step + 1;
                    vis[x][y] = 1;
                    Q.add(next);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        t = sc.nextInt();
        mat1 = new char[n + 1][n + 1];
        mat2 = new char[n + 1][n + 1];
        flag = new int[n + 1][n + 1];
        vis = new int[n + 1][n + 1];
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            sc.next().getChars(0, n + 1, mat1[i], 1);
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            sc.next().getChars(0, n + 1, mat2[i], 1);
        }
        SAP sap = new SAP(2 * n * n + 1);
        int source = 0, sink = 2 * n * n + 1;
        sap.init(sink + 1);
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (mat1[i][j] >= '1' && mat1[i][j] <= '9') {
                    sap.addCap(source, ID(i, j), mat1[i][j] - '0');
                }
                if (mat1[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    sx = i; sy = j;
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                sap.addCap(ID(i, j), ID(i, j) + n * n, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
                if (mat2[i][j] >= '1' && mat2[i][j] <= '9') {
                    sap.addCap(ID(i, j) + n * n, sink, mat2[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        BFS1();
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (mat1[i][j] >= '1' && mat1[i][j] <= '9') BFS2(i, j);
            }
        }
        int res = sap.solve(source, sink);
        System.out.println(res);
    }
}
